summary: 建立 replica→rack 與 replica→power_domain 兩種關係；輸出此次事件的可用副本與不可用原因。
summaryEn: Build separate replica-to-rack and replica-to-power-domain relations. Emit surviving replicas and explicit reasons for each unavailable copy, retaining both topology dimensions in the evidence.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

quiz.questionEn: Ceph CRUSH: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Which is case context to establish from the named official source, rather than a fault hypothesis or disposition?
options: 副本不可用可能是共同供電失效，也可能是網路隔離；不同 rack 的 CRUSH 設定本身無法區別；對照電源、網路與 OSD 活性事件，追蹤共同祖先；不要把應用 quorum 規則從副本數自行推定。
驗收只針對明定的單 PDU 事件與存活副本門檻；多 PDU、控制面與網路故障仍需別的測試矩陣。
副本分散到不同 rack 仍可能共用同一 PDU 或 UPS；本課超越單一階層檢查，加入跨層相關失效標籤。
optionsEn: Replica unavailability may come from shared power failure or network isolation. A rack-aware CRUSH placement rule alone cannot identify the actual cause or establish independence from unmodeled infrastructure. Compare power, network and OSD-liveness observations and trace shared ancestors. Do not infer a particular application’s quorum or Ceph pool’s write-availability policy from replica count alone.

Limit acceptance to the stated single-PDU event and surviving-copy threshold. Multiple power failures, control-plane dependencies and network faults require additional scenarios before broader availability claims.

Replicas placed in different racks can still depend on one upstream power domain. Extend a single hierarchy audit with correlated-failure labels instead of equating distinct rack names with independent power paths.

quiz.explanationEn: This step identifies case and source boundary. Replicas placed in different racks can still depend on one upstream power domain. Extend a single hierarchy audit with correlated-failure labels instead of equating distinct rack names with independent power paths. Interpret it with the investigation criterion: Evaluate each replica’s availability independently to obtain losses of two and one. Rename racks without changing power dependencies; the event outcome must remain invariant. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. Replica unavailability may come from shared power failure or network isolation. A rack-aware CRUSH placement rule alone cannot identify the actual cause or establish independence from unmodeled infrastructure. Compare power, network and OSD-liveness observations and trace shared ancestors. Do not infer a particular application’s quorum or Ceph pool’s write-availability policy from replica count alone.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.
steps.check: 逐副本布林判斷核對損失二與一；重新命名 rack 不可改變電源事件結果，確認模型未用名稱猜獨立性；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
steps.checkEn: Evaluate each replica’s availability independently to obtain losses of two and one. Rename racks without changing power dependencies; the event outcome must remain invariant. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.

knowledge.title: 案例與來源邊界
knowledge.text: 副本分散到不同 rack 仍可能共用同一 PDU 或 UPS；本課超越單一階層檢查，加入跨層相關失效標籤。
knowledge.textEn: Replicas placed in different racks can still depend on one upstream power domain. Extend a single hierarchy audit with correlated-failure labels instead of equating distinct rack names with independent power paths.

knowledge.textEn: Build separate replica-to-rack and replica-to-power-domain relations. Emit surviving replicas and explicit reasons for each unavailable copy, retaining both topology dimensions in the evidence.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 給定故障事件集合，失去副本數為其電源祖先被事件覆蓋的副本基數；不是將每個中間節點重複計次。
knowledge.textEn: For a specified failure event, lost replicas are those whose power ancestry intersects the failed domain set. Count replicas once, not every failed intermediate component along their dependency paths.

steps.objectiveEn: Complete accept and hand over evidence for Ceph CRUSH: construct traceable inputs and ownership and produce reviewable evidence against the investigation criterion.
steps.instruction:
交付雙拓撲、故障注入結果與範圍表；模型僅移除圖節點，不實際停用設備。
在交接件中加入「Ceph CRUSH：建立可追溯輸入與所有權」的原始資料、計算版本及下列驗收逐項結果：逐副本布林判斷核對損失二與一；重新命名 rack 不可改變電源事件結果，確認模型未用名稱猜獨立性；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
以本課決策條件作有條件結論：建立 replica→rack 與 replica→power_domain 兩種關係；輸出此次事件的可用副本與不可用原因。 請接手者依同一輸入重作一項檢查，保留差異與未結案項。
steps.instructionEn:
Deliver both topologies, graph fault-injection results and a scope table. The exercise removes nodes only from a local model and never powers down equipment or modifies a live storage cluster.
Include raw data, calculation revision, and each acceptance result for Ceph CRUSH: construct traceable inputs and ownership: Evaluate each replica’s availability independently to obtain losses of two and one. Rename racks without changing power dependencies; the event outcome must remain invariant. Preserve provenance, synthetic inputs and explicit join or ownership failures; do not silently fill missing values.
Use the course decision condition for a conditional conclusion: Build separate replica-to-rack and replica-to-power-domain relations. Emit surviving replicas and explicit reasons for each unavailable copy, retaining both topology dimensions in the evidence. Ask the receiving role to repeat one check with the same inputs and retain discrepancies and open issues.
steps.observation: 接手者能從輸入重現驗收，且剩餘風險有負責人。逐副本布林判斷核對損失二與一；重新命名 rack 不可改變電源事件結果，確認模型未用名稱猜獨立性；保存來源、合成輸入及 join/所有權失敗的明確原因；不得悄悄補缺值。
